component.name: APRS & Packet
component.summary: APRS station and packet radio terminal for a KISS TNC
APRS stanice a packet radio terminál pro KISS TNC

description.p: Turns a radio with a KISS TNC into an APRS station and a packet radio terminal. Made for the Quansheng UV-K1/UV-K5 V3 with the F4HWN firmware, but any KISS TNC works: Direwolf, a hardware TNC, or a radio on a USB serial port or on the network.

ul.li: Map of the stations heard, with their APRS symbols
APRS messages as conversations, retried until acknowledged
Stations heard on the radio or on APRS-IS, with distance and direction
Packet terminal for BBSes and nodes (AX.25 connected mode)
Packet chat and a TNC-style frame monitor

description.p: Transmitting is off until you switch it on; it is for licensed radio amateurs only.

Z rádia s KISS TNC udělá APRS stanici a packet radio terminál. Dělané pro Quansheng UV-K1/UV-K5 V3 s firmwarem F4HWN, funguje ale s jakýmkoli KISS TNC: Direwolf, hardwarové TNC, nebo rádio na USB sériovém portu či v síti.

ul.li: Mapa slyšených stanic s jejich APRS symboly
APRS zprávy jako konverzace, opakované do potvrzení
Stanice slyšené rádiem nebo přes APRS-IS se vzdáleností a směrem
Packet terminál pro BBS a nody (AX.25 spojení)
Packet chat a monitor rámců jako na TNC

description.p: Vysílání je vypnuté, dokud ho nezapneš; je jen pro radioamatéry s licencí.

description.p: BBS SERVER: run your own packet BBS, configured in files and in Settings. The terminal shows connect attempts and can stop them.
A section for the weekly #APRSThursday net (check in, the group's messages, when the next net starts) and a list of saved BBSes in the terminal.
Station labels on the map have a dark frame, and a button mutes the map's colours so the stations stand out.
Polish translation. The chat no longer shows automatic frames such as digipeater DX reports.
Stations and messages that an iGate relays from the internet by radio are now shown: the station on the map, the message in your inbox, acknowledged by radio.
The monitor can hide stations from the internet (APRS-IS) and show only radio traffic. Windows installer.
Thirteen more languages: Danish, German, Spanish, French, Croatian, Italian, Norwegian, Brazilian Portuguese, Slovak, Slovenian, Serbian, Swedish and Ukrainian.
Choose light, dark or the system's appearance; better detection of a dark desktop.
Own Flatpak repository with automatic updates. Right-click the map to set your position. More compact settings.
Tells you when a new version is out (checked at most once a day; can be switched off).
Closing the window asks first, so receiving and the beacon are not stopped by accident.
A legend for the map and the station list, names for all APRS symbols, and a choice to show stations seen only on the internet.
Packaged for installing from a software centre: Flatpak and Debian packages, an app icon. An About window with links to the source, the F4HWN firmware and the author.
First standalone version: map, APRS messages, stations, packet terminal, chat, monitor and APRS-IS.
